answer: To forge a sybil-resistant agent economy, require every agent to lock a 2,000 POA bond for 90 days before it can earn, with the bond slashed on proven fraud. A single honest agent pays nothing beyond the lock, but an attacker spinning up 500 fake identities must freeze 1,000,000 POA for three months, capital no bot farm recovers by farming. Over the horizon, honest agents build a dune of earned reputation that compounds, while sybils restart from zero each time, so faking scale costs more than it ever returns.
